Thanks for the quick intros last week. Were ready to lock in the DPA review + SOC 2 walkthrough and a pen-test kickoff session. Our security team (security_ops@atlaspay.com) would like to attend live for the pen-test planning portion.

Can you propose two candidate windows next week (one morning ET, one late-afternoon ET / early EMEA overlap)?

Attached: atlas_impact_matrix.xlsx (high-level mapping of systems / data flows).

Priya,

Great—thanks for the matrix, thats helpful. We can support both formats; our recommendation depends on how deep you want the pen-test scoping to be. Practical suggestions:

- Option A: Two sessions (90m controls/evidence; 60-90m pen-test scoping). This reduces context-switching for your ops team.
- Option B: Single 150-180m block if you prefer fewer meetings. We find shorter focused sessions reduce follow-ups.

Proposed candidate windows next week (all ET):
1) Tue 22 Jun 2027, 10:00-11:30 AM ET (controls/evidence) + Wed 23 Jun, 3:00-4:30 PM ET (pen-test scoping)
2) Wed 23 Jun, 1:00-3:30 PM ET (combined)

From Redwood: myself (compliance), Hannah (audit lead), Marcus Lin (pen-test engineer) will attend. Marcus will take the lead on the pen-test scope items.

Pre-work: a network diagram and a short list of where logs/audit trails live is the most useful. If you can drop those in the shared Drive link below before COB Monday it speeds the session up.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cComplianceAtlasPay

Ill leave it with Hannah to confirm preferred windows and we can then send a calendar invite.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Compliance Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
